summary: Smith & Nephew PLC filed a Form 6-K to report a TR-1 notification from Cevian Capital II GP Limited, disclosing a 12.074% voting rights stake as of June 8, 2026, up from 11.183%. Cevian holds the stake indirectly through Cevian Capital II Master Fund L.P. (10.89%) and a co-investment vehicle (1.18%), with Aurora Nominees as legal owner and UBS as custodian. While the filing states the reason as an acquisition of voting rights, the threshold breach and Cevian's known activist profile suggest an activist campaign. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The registrant's non-US filing maps to a Schedule 13D equivalent. Watch for Cevian's next moves and potential board or strategic changes; risk-arb angle is limited as no premium or transaction is offered.
